description.en: Accelerating exit: things leave faster than they arrive.
description.id: Keluar yang makin cepat: elemen pergi lebih cepat daripada datang.

description.en: Critically damped spring (damping 1.0, response 0.4 s) sampled for CSS. Pair with --ds-duration-spring. No overshoot.

description.en: Spring with 1.5% overshoot (damping 0.8, response 0.35 s). Pair with --ds-duration-spring-bounce. Only for momentum-driven motion.
description.id: Spring dengan overshoot 1,5% (damping 0,8, response 0,35 s). Pasangkan dengan --ds-duration-spring-bounce. Hanya untuk gerak yang digerakkan momentum.
